scenarios.prompt: An attack sprite has six cells, but the active hitbox should exist only on logical ticks 4–5 and hitstop may hold the contact pose. Define the pixel-animation mapping without changing gameplay timing.

criteria.ownership: Presentation cells map to authored logical timing; they do not own hitbox/hurtbox rules.
criteria.invariant: Logical contact ticks and duplicate-hit behavior remain unchanged across render FPS and hitstop.
criteria.evidence: Requires frame/tick stepping or equivalent observable timing evidence; no unrun runtime pass is claimed.
